title: In vitro Genotoxicity and In silico Docking Analyses of the Essential Oils of Thuja orientalis.
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接评估侧柏精油成分与B-DNA的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模，但对象为小分子-DNA而非TF-DNA，方法仅用AutoDock Vina，深度有限。
abstract: Two main objectives were pursued to assess the reliability of Thuja orientalis essential oils (TOEO). The first objective was to extract TOEO, analyze them by GC-MS, and determine their in vitro genotoxicity against selected plants using the RAPD-PCR method. The second objective was to evaluate the in-silico toxicity of TOEO. The binding sites and energies of each content was calculated against B-DNA. In-silico analyses were performed using a simulation program, AutoDock Vina, and Toxicity Estimation Software Tools. 3-carene, cedrol, and 2-pinene were identified as the predominant components. In vitro studies showed that the TOEO had a more significant impact on reducing genomic stability in wheat compared to the amaranth. The lowest stability was determined as 39.78 % in wheat and 53.58 % in amaranth. Cedrol (-5,7 kcal/mol) and selinene (-5,6 kcal/mol) exhibited the highest binding affinity. The toxicity test indicated that components other than cyclohexene may have toxic effects, none of them were predicted to be mutagenic, and LD(50) (mol/kg) values could vary between 1.33 and 1.55.
abstract_zh: 为实现对侧柏（Thuja orientalis）精油的可靠性评估，设定了两个主要目标。第一个目标是提取TOEO，通过GC-MS进行分析，并利用RAPD-PCR方法测定其对选定植物的体外遗传毒性。第二个目标是评估TOEO的计算机模拟（in-silico）毒性。针对B-DNA计算了各成分的结合位点和结合能。计算机模拟分析使用模拟程序AutoDock Vina和毒性估算软件工具（Toxicity Estimation Software Tools）进行。3-蒈烯（3-carene）、雪松醇（cedrol）和2-蒎烯（2-pinene）被鉴定为主要成分。体外研究表明，与苋菜相比，TOEO对降低小麦基因组稳定性的影响更为显著。最低稳定性在小麦中测定为39.78%，在苋菜中为53.58%。雪松醇（-5.7 kcal/mol）和瑟林烯（selinene）（-5.6 kcal/mol）表现出最高的结合亲和力。毒性测试表明，除环己烯（cyclohexene）外的成分可能具有毒性效应，但均未预测具有致突变性，且LD(50)（mol/kg）值可能在1.33至1.55之间变化。
